metadata.notes: Model pricing and quality ratings verified from Replicate pricing pages. Quality ratings (1-10) are subjective developer assessments. Cost-efficiency = quality / cost (higher is better value).

models.description: Fastest FLUX model optimized for speed and cost. Great for rapid iteration and local development.
models.best_for: Rapid prototyping, high-volume generation, personal projects, and when speed matters most

models.description: Stable Diffusion XL - highly cost-effective open-source model with good quality for the price.
models.best_for: Budget-conscious projects, high-volume generation, experimentation, and learning

models.description: State-of-the-art model with excellent prompt following, visual quality, and output diversity. Supports up to 4096x4096 resolution.
models.best_for: High-resolution outputs, complex compositions, multi-reference generation, and when you need the absolute best quality

models.description: Google's latest text-to-image model with exceptional photorealism and ease of prompting.
models.best_for: Photorealistic images, marketing materials, professional content, product photography, and architectural visualizations

models.description: Fast, creative generation with strong text rendering capabilities at an economical price.
models.best_for: Text-heavy designs, posters, graphic design, advertising materials, and rapid iterations with text overlays

models.description: Faster, more economical version of Imagen when price or speed are more important than final image quality.
models.best_for: Quick iterations, high-volume work, prototyping, and when good quality at lower cost is acceptable

models.description: Strong prompt following and style control for both photoreal and illustrated outputs with character consistency.
models.best_for: Character consistency across multiple scenes, visual storytelling, in-context editing, and style preservation

models.description: State-of-the-art open-source 8B parameter model with precise control via JSON-native prompting. Enterprise-focused with licensed training data.
models.best_for: Iterative refinement workflows, precise control over lighting/composition/color/camera, enterprise applications requiring rights-clear data, both text-to-image and image-to-image

models.description: Premium FLUX model supporting up to 4MP resolution with excellent image quality and prompt adherence.
models.best_for: Ultra high-resolution professional work, detailed compositions, and when maximum quality is needed

models.description: Improved FLUX model with more consistent image quality and diversity. Great all-around choice.
models.best_for: General-purpose high-quality generation, complex scenes with fine details, creative content, and e-commerce visuals

models.description: Optimal balance between speed, cost, and quality with excellent text rendering.
models.best_for: General text-heavy designs, balanced quality/speed needs, and iterative design work

models.description: Highest quality Ideogram model with stunning realism and exceptional text rendering capabilities.
models.best_for: Professional designs with text, posters, advertisements, and when text legibility is critical

models.description: Versatile model capable of generating long texts and images in a wide variety of styles. SOTA on text-to-image benchmarks.
models.best_for: Multi-style generation, long text rendering, creative compositions, and style-flexible projects

models.description: First major text-to-image model with high-quality SVG output capability. Perfect for scalable graphics.
models.best_for: Logos, icons, vector graphics, scalable designs, and when you need SVG format output
